name: delete-subcommand
body: Add `apg project delete <name>` (the `cancel` alternative was considered and rejected: `delete` matches the node/edge `rm` vocabulary and `git branch -d` semantics). ACs: (a) it is a main-checkout operation dispatched from `cmd_project`, documented in `apg --help`; (b) it removes the abandoned project's worktree at `<main>/apg/.worktrees/<name>` and deletes its branch — for projects that are NOT merged; (c) the branch's commits are discarded — delete is the explicit abandon act and does not require the branch to be merged into the default branch.
